goal.description: What the user wants from this turn, in one self-contained sentence

questions.description: Only for clarify: short questions. Empty otherwise.

options.description: Two to four short suggested answers, or empty

multiple.description: True if more than one option can apply at once; false if they are alternatives

steps.description: The edits to make, in order, one per step

issues.description: What's wrong and where, one per item. Empty when ok.

reason.description: One sentence: why this is the common cause

common_cause.description: What the agent does or lacks that causes this across the calls, one or two sentences

suggestion.description: One concrete change to the agent that fixes it for all of these calls, naming the node

reason.description: One sentence: what the user wants now

agreed.description: The user clearly wants the fix applied now

suggestion.description: The fix as it stands now (final when agreed), a concrete edit naming the node

reply.description: Your answer to the user when not agreed; empty when agreed
